title: Year 1989

body_markdown:
EVEREADY® leads the industry in environmental initiatives and offers the first zero-added mercury product.


The Energizer Bunny® is born – his TV debut.


1989


Union Carbide sells the Eveready Battery Company to Ralston Purina Company.


1986


The Company introduces the first fluorescent flashlight, requiring less frequent bulb changing.


1983
